prompt:
Use the supplied image as the exact opening frame and visual anchor. Create one continuous five-second locked-camera shot of this blue-and-white porcelain landscape. Preserve the composition, mountain silhouettes, solid porcelain volumes, cobalt decoration, pavilion, arched bridge, trees, single boat, warm ivory background, lighting and negative space.

Only animate water inside the three existing white waterfall channels: a gentle continuous downward flow following the existing drop and riverbed, with small coherent ripples where each waterfall meets the pool. The surrounding porcelain terrain stays completely rigid. Keep the water white and pale blue, retain readable detail and restrained motion. A very thin veil of mist may drift slowly close to the water, without hiding architecture or changing the mountain shapes. The boat remains in its existing position for this controlled test.

No pan, zoom, orbit, cuts or transition. No mountain breathing, melting ceramic, crawling patterns, deformation of the pavilion or bridge, moving trees, extra boats, new objects, flickering colors or aggressive spray. No text, subtitles, music, speech or sound effects. The purpose is to test localized fluid motion while all structural anchors remain stable.
visual_observations: 开场保持瓷质山水、桥亭、松树与小舟构图。实际返回834×1112、5.04秒、24fps。
放大时间对照中可见瀑布末端泡沫、水纹和水面涟漪变化；严格流向和完整水体物理仍需结合原片复核。
检查帧中主要山体与亭桥没有明显换形或整体运镜。亭与桥的辅助特征跟踪最大中位位移分别约为图宽0.052%和0.044%；不将其当作三维几何真值。
小舟向左位移，未遵守固定船位的要求；船区特征位移最大中位数约为图宽3.26%。约2秒后，高处还出现了新的雾丝。
选定背景区域灰度均值从首帧235.36降至约0.21秒的200.63。文件还含非零音轨（峰值-21.7dB），未听审内容；比较默认静音，原片保留。
method: Unmodified AI original copied byte-for-byte; JPEG derivatives are analysis frames, not generated video replacements
query_transport_note: Official CLI query with duplicate GET body omitted; question_id remains in the original URL. No resubmission.
actual_sound_request_note: CLI --sound false was requested, but the installed i2v builder fixed the submitted body to sound=1. Returned audio track status is reported separately.
review_method: 25 chronological sampled frames, first/last anchor crops, five enlarged waterfall/pool samples, all-frame image-feature displacement, full video/audio decode; audio content not listened to
verdict: 水景有了变化，冻结边界还不够严格。
summary: 瀑布末端、局部水纹、水面涟漪和薄雾有时序变化，主要山体与亭桥保持可辨。小舟却向左移动，约2秒后高处出现新的雾丝；开场曝光下降。局部动态的范围仍有外溢，不能把这次样本当作所有非目标区域都已锁定。
next_revision: 保持已经稳定的山体、亭桥和青蓝纹样。下一轮先明确冻结船体、倒影和船周围水线，将雾气限制在瀑布落水处；单独检查瀑布流向与持续性，并锁定首帧曝光。
